page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.12xlarge is a high-frequency general-purpose instance virtualized via the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for multi-tier architectures.

Given its high-frequency dedicated CPU cores and balanced memory-to-core ratio, the ecs.hfg9i.12xlarge is suited for workloads requiring strong single-thread performance alongside multi-core scaling. Suitable use cases include application servers, web serving, medium-sized databases, and build systems where dedicated compute resources and consistent network throughput are required.
